raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 12
, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified the confluence coordinates, stating ~38.866 N, -90.118 W near St. Louis (the Mississippi–Missouri confluence at Confluence Point State Park) as the Mississippi–Ohio confluence. This confuses the Missouri River with the Ohio River; the Mississippi–Ohio confluence is at Cairo, Illinois (~36.99 N, -89.15 W).
